title: Data Analyst / Analytics Developer
description:
position summary

we are seeking a highly analytical and technically capable data analyst / analytics developer to join our growing technology team.

this role sits at the intersection of data, technology, and business operations. the ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills combined with hands-on coding and technical capabilities. this individual will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting and analytics solutions, building data pipelines and automated processes, and transforming raw data into actionable business intelligence.

the successful candidate will work closely with the technology team and business stakeholders to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop technology-driven solutions that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and organizational performance.

this is not a traditional reporting-only data analyst position. we are looking for someone who can write code, work directly with databases, automate data processes, build analytical tools, and collaborate with software developers and tech leadership.

key responsibilitiesdata analysis & business intelligence

* analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities.
* translate business questions into meaningful data analyses and actionable insights.
* develop recurring and ad hoc reporting for business and technology leadership.
* create dashboards, visualizations, and analytical tools that clearly communicate key performance indicators and trends.
* establish and monitor key performance metrics.
* identify data quality issues and work with tech team and stakeholders to resolve them.
* perform root-cause analysis and investigate unexpected results or changes in business performance.
* present analytical findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

sql & database development

* write complex sql queries to extract, transform, and analyze data.
* work directly with relational databases and data warehouses.
* develop queries, views, stored procedures, and other database objects as appropriate.
* assist with database design and optimization.
* combine data from multiple systems and sources to create comprehensive datasets.
* maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency.
* develop repeatable processes for data extraction and transformation.

coding & data automation

* use programming languages such as python, sql, javascript, or similar technologies to analyze and manipulate data.
* develop scripts and applications that automate repetitive data-related tasks.
* build automated data pipelines and workflows.
* replace manual excel-based processes with scalable, technology-driven solutions.
* develop tools that enable business users to access and analyze information more efficiently.
* collaborate with tech team to incorporate data functionality into applications.
* develop apis where appropriate to facilitate data exchange between systems.

data integration

* work with data from internal applications, databases, apis, and third-party platforms.
* develop processes to collect, transform, validate, and consolidate data from multiple sources.
* troubleshoot data integration and data-quality issues.
* partner with developers and technology leadership to improve the organization's overall data architecture.

process improvement & automation

* work with business teams to understand existing processes and identify opportunities for data-driven improvement.
* identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient data workflows.
* design and implement automated solutions that improve speed, accuracy, and scalability.
* analyze operational processes to determine where data and technology can create efficiencies.
* help establish standardized data processes and reporting methodologies.

technology & product collaboration

* collaborate with software engineers, tech leadership, and business stakeholders.
* participate in application development projects where data and analytics are central to the solution.
* provide data requirements and technical specifications for new applications.
* test new applications, integrations, and data functionality.
* assist in defining data structures and requirements for new technology initiatives.
* contribute to the organization's broader technology and data strategy.

ai & emerging technologies

* explore opportunities to leverage ai and machine learning to improve data analysis and business processes.
* work with approved ai tools and apis to develop data-driven applications and automation.
* assist with developing ai-enabled reporting, analytics, and workflow solutions.
* evaluate emerging data and ai technologies and make recommendations.
* ensure appropriate security and confidentiality controls are incorporated into data and ai solutions.

data security & governance

* maintain strict controls around confidential, proprietary, client, and company data.
* follow established data security, privacy, and cybersecurity policies.
* ensure appropriate access controls are applied to sensitive information.
* identify potential data security and integrity issues.
* follow data governance standards and help establish appropriate data-management practices.
* ensure analytical solutions are developed with security and confidentiality in mind.

required qualifications

* bachelor's degree in data analytics, computer science, information systems, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, or a related field preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data development, or a related technical role.
* strong sql skills and experience working with relational databases.
* demonstrated programming experience in python, javascript, or another programming language.
* strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* experience manipulating, transforming, and analyzing large datasets.
* experience building dashboards and data visualizations.
* ability to translate business requirements into technical and analytical solutions.
* strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* excellent written and verbal communication skills.

preferred technical skills

experience with several of the following is preferred:

**programming & data**

* python
* sql
* javascript / typescript
* pandas
* numpy
* rest apis
* json
* etl / elt

**databases**

* sql server
* postgresql
* mysql
* snowflake
* databricks or similar data platforms

**analytics & visualization**

* power bi
* tableau
* looker
* excel
* data visualization libraries

**technology**

* git / github
* aws
* microsoft azure
* docker
* cloud-based data platforms
* ci/cd environments

**ai & automation**

* generative ai apis
* large language model integrations
* workflow automation
* machine learning fundamentals
* ai-assisted data analysis

candidates do not need to have experience with every technology listed above. a strong foundation in sql, programming, analytics, and problem solving is more important than familiarity with a particular technology stack.

what makes this role different

this position is designed for someone who wants to go beyond traditional data reporting. the successful candidate will be expected to analyze data, write code, build solutions, and improve the systems that produce the data.

examples of potential projects include:

* automating a manually maintained management report.
* building a centralized dashboards.
* creating apis between business systems.
* developing automated quality-control processes.
* building predictive or trend-based analytics.
* creating data tools for internal users.
* developing ai-assisted analytics and reporting.
* improving the organization's data architecture and reporting infrastructure.

key performance expectations

success in this position will be measured by the individual's ability to:

* **produce accurate insights** — deliver reliable, actionable analysis that supports business decision-making.
* **automate manual work** — replace repetitive data processes with scalable automated solutions.
* **improve data quality** — identify and resolve data integrity and quality issues.
* **build technical solutions** — develop scripts, applications, dashboards, and integrations that solve real business problems.
* **improve efficiency** — use data and technology to streamline business processes.
* **collaborate effectively** — work effectively with other analysts, developers, technology leadership, and business teams.
* **innovate** — identify practical applications for ai, automation, and emerging technologies.

pay: $160,000.00 - $165,000.00 per year

title: Senior AI / ML Engineer - Generative AI & Azure
description:

we are looking for a **senior ai / ml engineer** to join our data, ai & energy practice. in this role, you will design, build and deploy production-ready ai applications that integrate with complex enterprise data platforms, asset telemetry and mission-critical workflows.

this is more than a prompt engineering or prototype-focused position. you will work within an empowered agile delivery team to architect scalable retrieval-augmented generation (rag) applications, agentic workflows and ai-powered services on the microsoft azure ecosystem. you will partner with data engineers, software developers, cloud architects and business stakeholders to turn advanced ai capabilities into reliable, measurable business outcomes.

the ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with strong python, azure ai, cloud-native deployment and data integration experience. experience in energy, industrial operations, iot telemetry or similarly complex business domains is a strong advantage.

req# 1098563370

**responsibilities**

* design and develop end-to-end generative ai applications using azure openai, azure ai foundry and microsoft copilot studio
* architect and implement rag solutions, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, vector indexing, retrieval, reranking and response orchestration
* build agentic ai workflows that integrate enterprise knowledge, apis, tools and business processes
* develop secure, high-performance backend apis and microservices using python
* integrate ai services with existing enterprise applications and backend platforms, including .net/c# services where needed

* work with data engineering teams to connect ai applications with data platforms such as azure data factory, azure synapse and databricks
* implement vector storage, semantic search, caching and retrieval capabilities using azure ai search and related azure services
* participate in architecture reviews, code reviews and technical design discussions
* help establish engineering standards for ai application quality, security, observability, testing and operational support
* collaborate closely with product owners, data engineers, architects and energy-domain stakeholders to translate business problems into practical ai solutions

**requirements**

* 4+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering or a related technical discipline
* strong production-level development experience in python
* hands-on experience building applications with azure openai
* strong understanding of llms, prompt engineering, rag architectures, embeddings and vector search
* experience with azure ai search, including vector indexing and retrieval patterns
* experience designing and building rest apis, microservices or distributed backend services
* practical experience with docker and cloud application deployment
* experience deploying solutions using azure services such as aks, azure app services and/or azure functions
* experience working with data platforms or pipelines built on databricks, azure data factory or azure synapse

* experience using azure ai foundry

* background in upstream oil & gas, wells, subsurface, production operations, industrial systems or iot/asset telemetry

* microsoft azure certifications, including: ai-102: azure ai engineer associate, az-204: developing solutions for microsoft azure, dp-100: designing and implementing a data science solution on azure

description:
data engineer 4

do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? at capital one, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. we are seeking **data engineers** who are passionate about marrying data with emerging technologies. in this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across capital one.

**what you’ll do:**

* collaborate with and across agile teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions in full-stack development tools and technologies
* influence a team of developers, data analysts and data scientists with deep experience in machine learning, distributed microservices, lakehouse architecture, and full-stack systems
* utilize programming languages such as python and spark, along with open-source relational and nosql databases, and cloud-based data warehousing platforms including databricks and snowflake
* share your passion for staying on top of trends in data, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal and external technology communities, and mentoring other members of the data community
* collaborate with product managers and software engineers to deliver robust cloud-first data solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of americans achieve financial empowerment
* independently design, build and deliver world-class cloud data solutions and applications with little or no support from supervisors or managers
* architect and enforce common data engineering design patterns to ensure code quality, maintainability, and reusability across data platforms and pipelines
* serve as an ambassador for the data engineering team, communicating technical concepts and data outcomes clearly to both internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and shared understanding
* design and build data pipelines and platforms with a focus on scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency, ensuring robust performance under increasing data volume and business demands
* implement data security standards, including encryption at rest/transit and fine-grained access control, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations

the travel data team is building an end-to-end travel platform designed to centralize product data and power premium customer experiences. you will lead key aspects of a large-scale, cross-cloud migration—unifying multi-cloud datasets into a central data lake using python, spark, and databricks. by architecting this foundational data backbone, you will directly enable real-time personalized recommendations, tailored travel offers, and intelligent user benefits. it’s an exciting opportunity for an engineer looking to solve complex, distributed system challenges while driving high-impact digital products at enterprise scale.

**basic qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a related quantitative field (statistics, economics, operations research, analytics, mathematics, engineering)
* at least 4 years of experience in application development (internship experience does not apply)
* at least 2 years of experience in distributed data
* at least 2 years of experience with sql
* at least 2 years of experience with one programming language (python, java, or scala)
* at least 2 years of experience in data pipeline design and development
* at least 1 year of experience in data modeling and designing end-to-end data solutions using both relational and non-relational database systems

**preferred qualifications:**

* 7+ years of experience in application development with demonstrated proficiency in python, sql, scala, or java
* 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating data workloads in at least one public cloud environment (aws, microsoft azure, or google cloud)
* 4+ years of experience building or supporting distributed data or compute workloads using tools such as emr, spark, glue, or databricks
* 4+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating real-time or streaming data pipelines
* 2+ years of experience working on data observability (e.g., monte carlo, splunk) or data orchestration tools (e.g., airflow, dagster)
* 4+ years of experience working with unstructured or semistructured data using nosql databases (e.g., mongodb, cassandra, dynamodb)
* 4+ years of experience designing and supporting data warehousing solutions (e.g., snowflake, redshift)
* 2+ years of experience working in an agile development environment
* 2+ years of experience developing user-centric reusable data products

title: Sr. Data Scientist - Commercial
description:
**what makes dhl great?** our people! we know each employee’s individual contributions make us the #1 express delivery and logistics company in the world.

***distinguished as no. 1 world’s best workplace™ by great place to work and fortune magazine***

dhl express is committed to maintaining an environment that empowers every team member to make the greatest possible impact on our business. our culture is about personal commitment – to our business, to each other and to our global communities. dhl is dedicated to being a great place to work. in addition to competitive compensation packages, our employees enjoy a range of programs, services and benefits that bring the best to their personal lives.

**start your career with dhl today…**

the **sr.** **data scientist- commercial** **is** responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and optimizing advanced analytics, machine learning, and decision science solutions that drive commercial growth, revenue optimization, and data-driven decision-making across the u.s. commercial organization. the role applies predictive, prescriptive, and optimization techniques to improve pricing strategy, customer segmentation, sales effectiveness, forecasting accuracy, customer retention, and overall commercial performance.

working closely with commercial leadership, pricing, sales, marketing, finance, and business intelligence teams, this position transforms complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions and actionable insights. the role supports the full analytics lifecycle, including data acquisition, preparation, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, governance, and continuous improvement.

the data scientist also partners with stakeholders to operate analytical solutions through automation workflows, dashboards, and decision-support tools that enable measurable business impact. success in this role is demonstrated through improved commercial outcomes, enhanced forecasting capabilities, greater operational efficiency, and increased adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization.

**key accountabilities:**

**advanced analytics & machine learning**

* develop, validate, deploy, and optimize predictive, prescriptive, and optimization models that support commercial and strategic business objectives using advanced statistical analysis, machine learning, and ai techniques.
* build analytical models for forecasting, pricing and elasticity analysis, customer segmentation, propensity modeling, opportunity scoring, resource allocation, and scenario planning to drive data-informed business decisions.
* perform feature engineering, model selection, training, testing, validation, backtesting, and performance monitoring while evaluating emerging analytical methodologies and technologies to enhance model effectiveness and business value.

**data engineering & preparation**

* acquire, integrate, cleanse, and transform data from multiple internal and external sources while designing, developing, and maintaining scalable dataiku workflows, python pipelines, and sql processes leveraging snowflake and enterprise data platforms.
* ensure data quality, reproducibility, scalability, and governance across analytical environments by applying version control, development best practices, and collaborative processes that support efficient model development and deployment.

**model deployment & lifecycle management**

* support the end-to-end deployment of machine learning and analytical solutions using dataiku automation, snowflake processes, and modern mlops practices while monitoring model performance, accuracy, drift, stability, and business impact through established governance frameworks.
* coordinate model retraining, optimization, and continuous improvement activities while maintaining comprehensive model documentation, validation records, and model cards throughout the model lifecycle.

**business insights & decision support**

* translate complex analytical outputs into actionable business recommendations by identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers through advanced analytics and exploratory data analysis.
* develop analytical frameworks that support strategic planning, pricing, forecasting, and sales effectiveness, while measuring and communicating business value through kpi trees, lift analyses, roi scorecards, and performance metrics.

**visualization & bi integration**

* collaborate with the sales support business intelligence team to embed predictive and prescriptive insights into dashboards, reporting tools, and decision-support platforms.
* develop intuitive visualizations and analytical storytelling approaches for technical and non-technical audiences.

**cross-functional collaboration**

* partner with cross-functional teams to identify analytics-driven improvement opportunities, gather business requirements, and develop scalable data science solutions that support strategic business objectives.
* present analytical findings and provide subject matter expertise in advanced analytics and machine learning to stakeholders across all organizational levels, enabling informed decision-making and strategic initiatives.

**skills/qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics, operations research, or a related quantitative discipline.
* master's degree in data science, analytics, statistics, computer science, or a related field preferred.
* 4+ years of applied experience in data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, or decision science roles.
* demonstrated experience developing and deploying predictive and prescriptive models in a business environment.
* experience supporting commercial, pricing, marketing, customer analytics, forecasting, or revenue optimization initiatives preferred.
* proficiency in python, including pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, tensorflow, pytorch, or equivalent machine learning frameworks.
* advanced sql skills with experience working in snowflake or similar cloud-based data platforms.
* hands-on experience with dataiku or comparable analytics and machine learning platforms.
* experience utilizing git, version control processes, and collaborative software development practices.
* familiarity with mlflow, ci/cd pipelines, mlops frameworks, model monitoring, and drift detection methodologies.
* experience integrating predictive outputs into power bi, tableau, or other business intelligence platforms.
* strong knowledge of statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, predictive modeling, optimization, simulation, and experimental design methodologies.
* ability to translate complex analytical concepts into business-focused insights and recommendations.
* strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and data storytelling capabilities.
* excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Software Development Engineer- Product Reliability Engineering
description:
**about us**  
visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

at visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

join visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. progress starts with you.

**job description**

every time someone taps, swipes, or clicks to pay- visa infrastructure makes it happen in milliseconds, across 200+ countries. as a software development engineer on the product reliability engineering (pre) team, you won’t just watch those systems run- you’ll be one of the engineers building, automating, and evolving them.

pre is not a traditional ops team. we are a software engineering organization that treats infrastructure as code, reliability as a product, and automation as a strategic advantage. you’ll write python, build agentic ai tools, manage data platforms, and contribute to the distributed systems that process billions of real-time transactions. from day one, you are an engineer- and from day one, your work matters.

if you are endlessly curious about how large-scale systems stay resilient, obsess over elegant automation, and want to launch your career at the intersection of ai, infrastructure, and global financial technology — this role was built for you.

**build automation that scales**

* design and ship end-to-end automation for deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and release orchestration — code that runs millions of times so engineers never have to repeat themselves.
* write clean, production-grade python (and go or bash where it counts) to eliminate toil, reduce manual intervention, and make systems self-managing.
* develop modular frameworks for release scheduling, validation, rollback, and reporting that integrate across the full software delivery lifecycle.

**manage & evolve data platforms**

* support the build, deployment, and operations of relational database systems, contributing to schema design, architecture decisions, and solution engineering for critical payment data infrastructure.
* gain exposure to real-time event streaming architectures that support payment processing at scale
* perform database health operations including patching, upgrades, backups, and recovery to maintain the availability and integrity of tier-1 production databases.
* optimize query performance through index tuning, execution plan analysis, and replication monitoring — targeting metrics like query execution time, cpu usage, and replication latency.
* automate database tasks and configuration management using tools like ansible and liquibase, and contribute to ci/cd pipelines that govern schema changes through test and prod environments safely.
* build predictive and reactive monitoring dashboards for database anomalies, surfacing health signals before they become incidents.

**ship agentic ai & ml-powered tools**

* build genai-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment lifecycle management.
* integrate llms into observability, incident response, and developer support workflows, transforming reactive operations into proactive, ai-driven intelligence.
* contribute to prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and agentic automation initiatives that position pre as one of the most ai-forward reliability organizations in financial technology.

**own observability & platform health**

* build dashboards, alerts, and metrics using prometheus, grafana, splunk, or elk that give engineers real-time clarity on complex, globally distributed systems.
* analyze system performance and availability data and turn insights into infrastructure improvements that prevent incidents before they occur.
* contribute to self-healing and auto-scaling capabilities that keep critical payment infrastructure resilient without human intervention.

**engineer for reliability & security**

* ensure infrastructure and data platforms meet security and compliance standards across cloud-native deployments supporting global financial services at scale.
* support zero-downtime deployment strategies and high-availability architectures that visa’s partners and billions of cardholders depend on around the clock.
* participate in threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and audit readiness activities as part of a team that treats security as a first-class engineering concern.

**collaborate, learn & grow fast**

* embed within agile squads, working alongside senior engineers, product managers, and global pre peers across sprint planning, reviews, and release discussions.
* document runbooks, sops, and engineering guides that make the team smarter, faster, and more autonomous over time.
* participate in on-call rotations (with robust support structures and mentorship) to build the incident response instincts that distinguish great reliability engineers.

visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

**qualifications**

**basic qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree, or 3+ years of relevant work experience

**preferred qualifications:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field (2023–2025 graduates preferred; december 2025 graduates welcome).
* solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and systems design -you can reason about complexity, tradeoffs, and failure modes.
* proficiency in python and comfort writing scripts or tools in at least one additional language (go, java, or bash).
* foundational understanding of relational databases (rdbms): sql, data modeling, query optimization, and database connectivity troubleshooting.
* familiarity with linux/unix environments and meaningful command-line fluency.
* exposure to cloud platforms (aws, gcp, or azure) and a conceptual understanding of containerization (docker, kubernetes).
* understanding of ci/cd principles and how modern software delivery pipelines are structured and maintained.
* genuine curiosity about genai platforms and agentic systems (openai, anthropic claude, langchain, or similar)- hands-on exposure is a plus, intellectual interest is a must.

**bonus points:**

* hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools: terraform, ansible, or pulumi -even from coursework, a capstone, or an internship.
* experience with database ci/cd tooling, particularly liquibase for schema change management across environments.
* experience with observability tooling: prometheus, grafana, splunk, elk, or datadog.
* database administration exposure: backup/recovery procedures, performance tuning, index management, or replication monitoring.
* familiarity with git workflows and modern devops toolchains (jenkins, github actions, argocd).
* academic or project experience with ml frameworks: scikit-learn, pytorch, or langchain / langgraph.
* understanding of networking fundamentals: dns, load balancing, service mesh, or tcp/ip.
* a github profile, personal project, hackathon entry, or open-source contribution that shows us how you think and build.

**information for us applicants**

visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), fsa/hsa, life insurance, paid time off, and wellness program.

**work hours**

varies upon the needs of the department.

**travel requirements**

this position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

**mental/physical requirements**

this position will be performed in an office setting. the position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

**visa is an eeo employer**

qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the eeoc guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior AI Ops / DevOps Engineer (FTE / Hybrid)
description:
**req id:** 390771
  
  
ntt data strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. if you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
we are currently seeking a senior ai ops / devops engineer (fte / hybrid) to join our team in atlanta, georgia (us-ga), united states (us).
  
  
day to day job duties
  
  
the senior ai ops / devops engineer will architect, build, and manage next-generation ai-driven ci/cd and cloud operations ecosystems. this role will go beyond traditional devops automation by integrating llm agents, model context protocol servers, intelligent observability, and secure ai-assisted workflows into the software delivery lifecycle.
  

* architect, build, and manage ai-enabled ci/cd pipelines that improve developer productivity, code quality, release reliability, and deployment speed.
* design and deploy production-grade model context protocol clients and servers to securely connect enterprise llms with engineering tools, repositories, cloud infrastructure, and observability platforms.
* develop custom mcp servers using python, typescript, node.js, or javascript to expose logs, infrastructure metrics, deployment data, and internal tools to authorized ai agents.
* integrate llm agents into developer workflows to support automated code review, vulnerability detection, test generation, release validation, and infrastructure recommendations.
* build and maintain robust ci/cd pipelines using github actions, gitlab ci, circleci, argocd, jenkins, or similar tools.
* implement chatops 2.0 capabilities that allow engineers to interact with deployment pipelines, cloud environments, logs, and operational workflows using secure conversational interfaces.
* create safe autonomous remediation workflows for log analysis, incident triage, root-cause analysis, and infrastructure issue resolution.
* build guardrails that allow ai agents to generate, inspect, and safely execute infrastructure as code using terraform, opentofu, terragrunt, pulumi, crossplane, or similar tools.
* manage containerized workloads using docker and kubernetes platforms such as aws eks, azure aks, or google gke.
* integrate ai-driven observability workflows with platforms such as datadog, prometheus, grafana, cloudwatch, splunk, dynatrace, or elk.
* implement ai safety controls including role-based access control, least-privilege execution, human-in-the-loop approvals, audit logging, rollback mechanisms, and secure tool access.
* partner with software engineering, devops, sre, security, platform, and data/ai teams to identify opportunities for intelligent automation.
* create reusable automation frameworks, runbooks, dashboards, documentation, and enablement materials for engineering teams.
* drive an “automate everything” culture by reducing manual toil and improving operational efficiency across cloud and software delivery processes.

basic qualifications
  

* minimum 7+ years of experience in devops, cloud engineering, sre, platform engineering, or infrastructure automation.
* minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience designing and managing ci/cd pipelines using github actions, gitlab ci, circleci, jenkins, argocd, or similar platforms.
* minimum 3+ years of experience managing scalable cloud environments in aws, azure, or gcp, with strong preference for aws.
* strong hands-on experience with kubernetes, docker, and production container orchestration platforms such as eks, aks, or gke.
* advanced proficiency with infrastructure as code tools such as terraform, opentofu, terragrunt, pulumi, cloudformation, or crossplane.
* strong programming and scripting experience using python, typescript, javascript, bash, or go.
* practical experience working with llm apis such as openai, anthropic, or similar enterprise ai platforms.
* experience with ai orchestration or agentic frameworks such as langchain, crewai, llamaindex, or similar tools.
* strong understanding of the model context protocol ecosystem and experience designing or integrating mcp clients and servers.
* experience integrating devsecops controls into ci/cd pipelines, including sast, dast, dependency scanning, container scanning, secrets scanning, and vulnerability management.
* strong knowledge of secret management and security tooling such as hashicorp vault, aws secrets manager, azure key vault, or similar platforms.
* experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and alerting platforms such as datadog, prometheus, grafana, cloudwatch, splunk, dynatrace, or elk.
* familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as soc2, iso27001, or enterprise audit control environments.
* ability to troubleshoot complex pipeline, infrastructure, deployment, and production issues across cloud-native environments.

preferred / nice to have
  

* experience building ai-assisted infrastructure provisioning workflows.
* experience implementing autonomous or semi-autonomous incident response and remediation capabilities.
* experience with mlops, model deployment pipelines, model monitoring, mlflow, sagemaker, or equivalent platforms.
* experience implementing human-in-the-loop approval models for ai-generated operational actions.
* experience with policy-as-code tools such as open policy agent, sentinel, checkov, or similar solutions.
* experience working in regulated industries such as banking, financial services, healthcare, or insurance.
* experience with gitops operating models using argocd, flux, or similar tools.
* aws, kubernetes, devops, security, or ai/ml certifications are a plus.

soft skills mindset
  

* strong “automate everything” mindset with a passion for reducing repetitive manual tasks and operational toil.
* security-first approach with practical skepticism of autonomous ai actions and a focus on validation, boundaries, approvals, and rollback.
* ability to bridge traditional software engineering, devops, sre, security, and data/ai teams.
* strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex ai-enabled devops concepts to both technical and leadership audiences.
* collaborative educator who can help upskill engineering teams on ai-assisted delivery, secure automation, and modern devops practices.
* ownership mindset with the ability to design solutions, implement them hands-on, and support them in production.

travel
  
  
this position requires 3 days in office per the client/project requirement.
  
  
degree
  
  
bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or equivalent work experience.
  
  
summary
  
  
the ideal candidate is a senior hands-on devops engineer with strong cloud, automation, kubernetes, and ci/cd expertise, combined with practical experience applying ai, llm agents, and mcp-based integrations to modern engineering workflows. this role will help create a secure ai-driven delivery ecosystem that accelerates software engineering velocity while maintaining strong governance, reliability, auditability, and operational control.

title: Sr. AI Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
why stifel:

stifel strives for a culture that puts its clients and associates first: a culture where everyone belongs, everyone is welcome, and everyone contributes to the success of our clients, their careers, and the firm as a whole.

let’s talk about how you can find your place here at stifel, **where success meets success**.

what you'll be doing:

the sr. ai cloud platform engineer is a member of the security engineering & automation team, the security organization's shared build capability, and is responsible for the platform architecture and hands-on engineering of secure, reusable capabilities that enable security teams to operate more efficiently and consistently. this role architects and develops shared security platforms, tool integrations, ai-enabled security capabilities, metrics and dashboarding services, proofs of concept, and automation that removes recurring manual work, built once and designed for adoption by multiple security pods rather than as one-off solutions. operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role partners with security architecture and cloud platform architects to align team-owned solutions with organizational standards and strategic direction. the team operates under a clear contract, security engineering & automation builds, and consuming pods configure, run, and report.

what we're looking for:

* lead the architecture and technical design of the team's shared capabilities — platforms, services, integrations, apis, data pipelines, and automation — built to be secure, scalable, resilient, and reusable.
* build shared security tool integrations and reusable automation that eliminate manual toil, reduce duplicated engineering effort, and improve consistency across security pods.
* architect ai solutions that both secure the organization's use of ai and apply ai to improve security operations, analysis, and decision support.
* build and maintain shared metrics, data, and dashboarding capabilities, including common data models and integration patterns, that enable automated, business-readable reporting across the security organization.
* partner with security architecture to embed security requirements, approved patterns, controls, and risk decisions into platform designs, and collaborate with enterprise and cloud platform architects to align with broader technology strategies and standards.
* translate business, security, operational, and regulatory requirements into platform designs and executable implementation plans.
* develop infrastructure as code using terraform, cloudformation, or cdk, and build automation and integrations using python, bash, powershell, aws lambda, step functions, apis, and event-driven and workflow orchestration services.
* embed identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, network controls, data protection, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement into team-owned solutions.
* conduct proofs of concept and technical evaluations to validate solution viability and inform build-versus-buy decisions, assessing technologies for technical fit, security, interoperability, supportability, cost, and reuse potential.
* create reusable reference architectures, implementation patterns, technical standards, and onboarding guidance, and contribute to the team's service catalog, including available capabilities, engagement criteria, and ownership expectations.
* define consumption, configuration, and support boundaries for team-built services in partnership with product management and consuming pods, along with measurable outcomes such as adoption, toil reduction, onboarding time, and data freshness.
* maintain the reliability, availability, observability, and security of shared team-owned platforms and their ci/cd and operational tooling, and support incidents and root-cause analysis while pod-specific operations, triage, and tool administration remain with the consuming pod.
* publish architecture diagrams, decision records, runbooks, and service documentation, and communicate evaluations, proof-of-concept results, roadmaps, and delivered business value through planning forums, demonstrations, and stakeholder reviews.
* mentor engineers and promote strong platform engineering, secure development, automation, and architecture practices within the team.

what you'll bring:

* strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify manual toil and design reusable capabilities that eliminate it.
* ability to effectively communicate technical topics and architectural decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.
* deep understanding of platform architecture principles, including scalability, reliability, observability, interoperability, and cost management.
* understanding of ai and llm-based systems, including generative ai, agentic workflows, and their security considerations.
* demonstrated ability to operate independently, lead technical design efforts, prioritize workload, and collaborate across organizational boundaries.
* experience architecting and developing reusable cloud or platform capabilities — integrations, automation, apis, or data pipelines — used by multiple teams.
* experience conducting proofs of concept, technical evaluations, and build-versus-buy assessments.
* experience incorporating security requirements and controls into cloud and platform solutions in partnership with security architecture or comparable governance functions.
* experience designing for measurable outcomes such as adoption, toil reduction, reliability, and onboarding efficiency.

education & experience:

* minimum required: bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, computer engineering, software engineering, data science, cybersecurity, or related field, or a related combination of education and experience.
* minimum required: 6+ years of platform, infrastructure, devops, cloud, automation, integration, security engineering, or software engineering experience; 3+ years of hands-on aws experience in production environments.
* minimum required: experience applying ai, machine learning, or generative ai to automation, engineering, or security use cases.
* preferred: experience with metrics platforms, apis, or workflow orchestration.
* preferred: experience supporting regulated or financial-services environments.

licenses & credentials:

* minimum required: aws certified solutions architect — associate or professional, or equivalent demonstrated aws expertise.
* preferred: aws certified devops engineer — professional.
* aws certified security — specialty, aws certified machine learning — specialty, hashicorp terraform associate, ccsp, cissp, or comparable cloud, ai, or platform engineering credentials, is a plus.

systems & technology:

* deep hands-on aws experience, including services such as ec2, vpc, iam, lambda, ecs/eks, s3, rds, cloudwatch, organizations, and control tower.
* experience with infrastructure as code (terraform, cloudformation, or cdk) and scripting and automation using python, bash, powershell, or similar languages.
* experience designing and integrating apis, event-driven services, workflow automation, and third-party security technologies for adoption by multiple teams.
* experience with ai and machine learning services such as amazon bedrock, amazon sagemaker, azure openai, or openai apis, including generative ai, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and model gateways.
* working knowledge of cloud and platform security, including iam least privilege, secrets management, encryption, network security, logging, monitoring, data protection, and policy-as-code.
* preferred: metrics, dashboarding, and data platforms such as grafana, power bi, quicksight, or opensearch.
* preferred: ci/cd tooling (github actions, azure devops, or jenkins), container orchestration (docker, kubernetes, or ecs/eks), and observability tooling (datadog, prometheus, or opentelemetry).
* preferred: experience with opa, aws config, service control policies, cloud security posture management, data-loss prevention, or automated guardrail technologies.

description:
**posting title**
=================

undergraduate / graduate (spring / summer) intern - cyber security research – 5g

.

**location**
============

co - golden

.

=================

intern (fixed term)

.

**hours per week**
==================

40

.

**working at nlr**
==================

nlr is located at the foothills of the rocky mountains in golden, colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.

join the national laboratory of the rockies (nlr), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. from our mission to our collaborative culture, nlr stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. our work helps strengthen u.s. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

at nlr, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. we offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.

  
  

**job description**
===================

the national laboratory of the rockies’ (nlr) cybersecurity research is strengthening our grid against tomorrow's threats. the selected intern would join the cyber mission assurance team to support research efforts within the cybersecurity research center’s portfolio including:

* characterization of the potential for u.s. electric grid disruption from natural hazards and human threats
* assessment of the cybersecurity of distributed energy systems
strengthening the resilience of the u.s. electric grid  

the cyber mission assurance team is looking for talented software or ai engineering interns to help build intelligent, data-driven applications for 5g and emerging 6g networks. this internship focuses on developing ric rapps, xapps, and dapps, along with nwdaf-based analytics, enabling closed-loop automation and ai-powered optimization across the ran and core network.

interns will work on cloud-native, microservice-based systems that apply machine learning and advanced analytics to real network data, contributing to next-generation autonomous networks.

**key responsibilities**

* design and implement **ric applications** :
  + **rapps** (non-real-time optimization and policy-driven automation)
  + **xapps** (near-real-time ran control and optimization)
  + **dapps** (distributed and domain-specific intelligent network functions)
* develop and enhance **nwdaf analytics functions** for performance monitoring, prediction, anomaly detection, and optimization
* build **ai/ml models** for network intelligence (forecasting, classification, reinforcement learning, root-cause analysis)
* implement **closed-loop automation workflows** using ai insights and ric control interfaces
* develop **cloud-native microservices** using containers and kubernetes
* integrate with **o-ran and 3gpp interfaces** (a1, e2, o1, service-based apis)
* process and analyze **large-scale, time-series and streaming network data**
* collaborate with cross-functional teams on design, testing, and validation
document software designs, experiments, and technical results  

**what you will learn:**

* end-to-end development of **ric rapps, xapps, and dapps** in 5g/6g systems
* practical implementation of **nwdaf-based analytics and ai pipelines**
* applying **ai/ml to closed-loop network automation**
* building **telecom-grade, scalable cloud-native software**
* insights into **6g intelligence, autonomous networks, and standardization trends**

.

**basic qualifications**
========================

"minimum of a 3.0 cumulative grade point average.
  
  
undergraduate: must be enrolled as a full-time student in a bachelor’s degree program from an accredited institution.
  
post undergraduate: earned a bachelor’s degree within the past 12 months. eligible for an internship period of up to one year.
  
  
graduate: must be enrolled as a full-time student in a master’s degree program from an accredited institution.
  
post graduate: earned a master’s degree within the past 12 months. eligible for an internship period of up to one year.
  
graduate + phd: completed master’s degree and enrolled as phd student from an accredited institution.
  
  
please note:
  

* applicants are responsible for uploading official or unofficial school transcripts, as part of the application process.
* if selected for position, a letter of recommendation will be required as part of the hiring process.

**additional required qualifications**
======================================

* currently pursuing a degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, ai/ml, or a related field
* strong programming skills in python, go, java, or c++
* demonstrated knowledge or experience in software engineering principles, data structures, and algorithms
* experience working in linux-based environments, command line, and networking
* demonstrated knowledge and/or experience with ai-driven systems, distributed software, and telecom networks
* knowledge or experience with data analytics pipelines such as one of the following:(kafka, prometheus, grafana, time-series databases)

**preferred qualifications**
============================

.

the anticipated closing window for application submission is up to 30 days and may be extended as needed.

==============================================================

title: Data & Integration Engineer
description:
**data & integration engineer**
===============================

**location:** austin, texas

**work arrangement:** full-time, onsite

**about integrated financial settlements**
------------------------------------------

for over 40 years, integrated financial settlements (ifs) has been transforming lives by helping people achieve financial stability after life-altering events or injuries. our innovative products and services provide long-term financial security, spendthrift protection, and peace of mind to vulnerable individuals navigating challenging circumstances. we're building the next generation of financial technology to serve our mission more effectively and at greater scale.

**our vision & values**
-----------------------

as a collaborative community, our passion is to introduce options that restore stability, encourage hope, and create possibilities for people impacted by injury. we help people navigate change by providing effective financial solutions to support their goals. our work is guided by four core values:

* **integrity:** do what is right
* **innovation:** seek opportunities to learn, improve, and encourage creative thought
* **collaboration:** we are better together. diversity of experience and thought enriches our work and lives
* **empathy:** acknowledge others and ask questions. listen to find out what is important

**the opportunity**
-------------------

this is a ground-floor opportunity to architect and build the core data and integration backbone of a growing financial services company. you'll design a greenfield enterprise data architecture, connecting internal platforms, third-party systems, banking partners, and external data sources into a unified operating platform. as one of the foundational members of our technology organization, you'll be responsible for creating the architectural patterns, integration frameworks, data models, and ai-ready infrastructure that power the next phase of our growth. you'll transform a business operating across fragmented systems into one powered by trusted data, automated workflows, intelligent decision-making, and secure financial transactions.

**what makes someone successful in this role**
----------------------------------------------

* you enjoy creating new capabilities from the ground up and are energized by solving complex problems with practical solutions
* you understand how technology enables revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk management, and customer experience
* you seek elegant solutions that reduce complexity and technical debt rather than introducing unnecessary technology
* you operate as if you own the platform and are accountable for its reliability, scalability, and long-term success
* you understand that successful ai initiatives depend on quality data, strong governance, semantic consistency, and effective integration patterns
* you can move between architecture, engineering, solution design, vendor management, troubleshooting, and strategic planning as business needs evolve
* you can operate independently with limited oversight while maintaining alignment with organizational objectives

**key responsibilities**
------------------------

* build and manage our enterprise data architecture, including canonical data models, data domains, governance standards, lineage, master data strategies, and quality controls
* design and implement a semantic layer that powers analytics, reporting, ai applications, and future agentic workflows
* define enterprise integration architecture, api standards, integration patterns, and reusable connectivity frameworks
* build and manage etl/elt pipelines, orchestration frameworks, event-driven processes, observability, monitoring, retry strategies, and operational support
* design secure and compliant data movement across internal, external, and regulated environments
* lead integration efforts with banking and payment systems, including ach, wire processing, payment networks, custodians, and financial infrastructure providers
* develop integration endpoints and services supporting salesforce, workflow platforms, customer applications, and external partners
* create data structures and architectures optimized for ai agents, machine learning models, retrieval systems, and intelligent automation
* establish scalable architectural patterns that support future business capabilities while minimizing technical debt
* partner closely with business and technology teams to translate business processes into scalable technical solutions
* evaluate emerging technologies related to ai, data engineering, integration platforms, and cloud architecture

**required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, integration engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, or related technical roles
* demonstrated experience building platforms with limited resources and small teams, with a track record of delivering practical solutions that scale as the business grows
* proven experience designing and implementing enterprise data platforms from architecture through production support
* hands-on experience integrating with banking, payment, fintech, or financial services platforms
* strong experience designing apis, integration services, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and distributed systems
* deep understanding of data modeling, canonical data design, master data management, governance, lineage, and data quality practices
* hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms such as snowflake, databricks, bigquery, redshift, or equivalent technologies
* experience building etl/elt solutions using tools such as airflow, matillion, fivetran, azure data factory, or equivalent platforms
* strong sql skills and proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as python, java, or c#
* experience implementing secure data transmission, encryption, authentication, authorization, and audit controls
* experience designing solutions for reliability, observability, scalability, compliance, and operational support
* ability to operate across architecture, engineering, and business discussions without requiring specialized teams for every decision

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* experience building ai-ready data architectures and semantic models
* experience implementing vector databases, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), knowledge graphs, or related ai infrastructure
* experience supporting ai agents, copilots, workflow automation, or agentic architecture
* familiarity with openai, anthropic, azure ai, aws ai services, or other enterprise ai platforms
* experience in integrating structured and unstructured data sources for ai and analytics use cases
* experience with real-time data streaming platforms such as kafka, event hub, kinesis, or pub/sub
* experience in highly regulated industries such as financial services, banking, lending, insurance, or payments
* prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth company where individuals were expected to operate across multiple disciplines

**work environment**
--------------------

* full-time, onsite position based in austin, texas
* 40-hour work week with flexibility to work extended hours as needed based on business needs
* regular verbal and written communication with cross-functional teams
* extended periods of sitting at a computer workstation
* dexterity required to operate computer keyboard, mouse, and other computer components
* light physical effort including occasional handling of objects up to 20 pounds and frequent handling of objects up to 10 pounds

**ready to build the future?**
------------------------------

if you're an experienced data and integration engineer excited about architecting enterprise platforms from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you. join our team and help us transform financial services for people who need it most.

**to apply, please submit your resume and a brief note about your experience with enterprise data architecture and integration projects.**

title: AI Automation Intern
description:
high five media is looking for an ai automation intern to build ai tools and automations that help our small business clients save time and grow, with the opportunity to move into a full-time position.

**overview**

this internship provides on-site ai and automation services to deliver cohesive, consistent, quality work to our clients. duties of this position will include building ai chatbots and assistants, workflow automations, ai-powered search over client data, machine learning solutions, and troubleshooting for small businesses. this position requires up to 30 hours per week and the ability to hit the "go live gong" when necessary.

**duties and responsibilities**

* understand the vision of a project for various clients by referencing the client brief
* meet with small business clients to understand how their business runs and find tasks that ai and automation can handle
* choose the right approach for each problem: a fixed workflow, an llm-powered workflow, or an ai agent that decides which tools and actions to use
* build workflow automations in n8n that connect the tools small businesses already use (crms, email, google workspace, google sheets, airtable, slack, forms, scheduling, and payments)
* build ai applications and agents that use tools, apis, and business data
* build rag (retrieval-augmented generation) systems that let clients search and chat with their own documents, websites, and data
* build ai chatbots, assistants, and voice agents for client websites, phone lines, customer support, and lead qualification
* build and apply machine learning models for small business needs, such as lead scoring, forecasting, and classifying customer data
* prove that every ai system works before it reaches a client: build test datasets, set evaluation criteria, measure accuracy and reliability, and find hallucinations
* re-test ai systems whenever prompts, models, or data change
* launch ai tools and automations to production and monitor their performance so they keep working
* keep client data, api keys, and ai systems secure and private
* document every automation and ai tool so clients and coworkers can use and maintain it
* work with the web development team to add ai features to client websites
* estimate how long tasks will take and meet those deadlines
* communicate project details effectively to high five account managers in a timely manner
* provide status reports on ai and automation projects to the project manager

**knowledge, skills, abilities**

***required***

* practical understanding of how large language models work: tokens, context windows, model selection, hallucinations and failure modes, and cost and speed tradeoffs
* experience with major ai models and platforms (openai, anthropic claude, google gemini, and open-source models)
* proficiency in python
* experience with apis, webhooks, and json
* prompt engineering, structured outputs (json schemas), and tool/function calling
* understanding of embeddings, semantic search, and rag
* understanding of when to use a fixed workflow, an llm-powered workflow, or an ai agent
* experience with n8n or a similar workflow automation tool (make, zapier)
* ability to test and evaluate ai systems: test datasets, evaluation criteria, accuracy, and reliability
* understanding of machine learning fundamentals: supervised and unsupervised learning, training and evaluating models, and when to use machine learning instead of an llm
* understanding of ai security and data privacy, including protecting api keys and preventing prompt injection
* working knowledge of git

***preferred***

* langchain, langgraph, llamaindex, or the openai/anthropic agent sdks
* vector databases (pinecone, supabase/pgvector, qdrant, or similar)
* understanding of mcp (model context protocol) and how ai systems connect to external tools and data
* experience with the newest ai platforms and agent tools, such as claude (including claude code), openai codex, chatgpt, cursor, and similar
* ai voice agents (vapi, retell, elevenlabs, twilio)
* self-hosting n8n and ai tools (docker, a vps, supabase)
* sql databases
* javascript
* machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, pytorch, or tensorflow
* experience with google sheets, airtable, crms, and small business tools (hubspot, sales for quickbooks, google workspace, or similar)
* experience building older websites (older php, static html, and older wordpress sites)

***all candidates***

* ability to explain ai to non-technical small business owners in plain language
* strong project management skills
* thrive in fast-paced environments, managing multiple projects and deadlines
* outstanding communication and writing skills
* creative, innovative, self-motivated, and organized
* ability to speak tactfully with clients under occasionally stressful circumstances
* experience with mac os
* must be able to establish and build relationships with coworkers appropriately
* good taste in music and the ability to wield a game controller is also a plus

**education and experience**

currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a program in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, software engineering, or a related field preferred. if not enrolled in or graduated from a program in the above fields, equivalent experience building ai tools and automations is required. all applicants must provide a portfolio of at least 2–3 projects showing that they can connect ai to real-world data, tools, or workflows, with links to live demos, screenshots, or videos, and a link to their code (github or similar). examples include:

* an ai chatbot connected to a knowledge base
* an n8n automation using an llm and apis
* a rag application
* an ai lead qualification system
* a document-processing pipeline
* an ai agent that uses tools
* a small machine learning prediction or classification project

**company general policy & procedure**

high five media maintains normal working hours of monday through friday, 8:00 a.m. until 5:00 p.m. should an employee have any questions or need to make changes to their regular work schedule, the employee should contact their supervisor. high five media requests that all work be done in the high five media office. only on rare occasions, with supervisor/partner approval, will an employee be able to work outside the office. the requirements listed above are representative of the job duties. employees must be able to demonstrate the knowledge and ability to perform their job duties satisfactorily and will be subject to regular employee evaluations. the information listed in this position description reflects an overall review of the duties considered essential to this position. the information listed should not be considered a full and complete description of all work requirements that may be involved in the position.

**physical demands**

the following physical demands are representative of activities that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential tasks of this position. reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential tasks of this position. while performing the duties of this position, the employee will be regularly required to use their hands to type, handle small job-related equipment, and use the telephone. the employee will occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and lift or move up to 20 pounds.

**compensation**

commensurate with experience

**job type:** internship

**schedule:**

* monday to friday

**experience:**

* ai / automation development: 1 year (preferred)

pay: $15.00 - $20.00 per hour

expected hours: 30.0 per week

work location: in person

title: Sr. Data Reliability Engineer I
description:
**who we are**
==============

dv is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners verify the quality of their digital campaigns, optimise to improve performance and prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. dv’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. since 2008, dv has helped hundreds of fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

**about the role**
==================

the senior data reliability engineer is an integral part of the data reliability (dre) team. you will analyze and externalize doubleverify's data internally, and you will monitor, troubleshoot, and improve the company's data pipelines and technologies.

the role combines hands-on operational work with development. you will investigate client-facing tickets and the business logic behind our data. you will also build automation and tooling that reduces manual ticket work and improves data quality at scale.

**key responsibilities:**

* gain in-depth knowledge of how data is collected, processed, and externalized to clients within doubleverify's architecture
* investigate and resolve client-facing tickets, including data investigations and analysis of the business logic behind our data
* develop automation and tooling that streamlines ticket handling and reduces recurring operational work
* script in python and sql extensively
* create reports and data visualizations using analysis tools such as splunk and grafana

description:
ntt data strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. if you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
we are currently seeking a cloud vulnerability management engineer (onsite hybrid) to join our team in atlanta, georgia (us-ga), united states (us).
  
  
**technology focus:** hybrid cloud / azure / aws / apache spark
  
**role focus:** cloud vulnerability management / devsecops / cloud security
  
  
**job responsibilities include:**  

* manage the end-to-end vulnerability management lifecycle for enterprise applications and infrastructure hosted across hybrid cloud, microsoft azure, and aws environments.
* analyze vulnerability scan results and identify security vulnerabilities affecting cloud infrastructure, operating systems, containers, application dependencies, open-source libraries, and cloud-hosted data platforms.
* perform vulnerability assessment and prioritization based on cve/cvss severity, exploitability, application criticality, external exposure, and overall business risk.
* work closely with application development, cloud engineering, devops, sre, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams to define and execute vulnerability remediation plans.
* support identification and remediation of vulnerabilities across aws and azure cloud services, linux/windows servers, kubernetes, containers, docker images, java applications, and open-source components.

* validate successful remediation through rescanning, technical verification, and security evidence collection.
* track critical and high vulnerabilities against established remediation slas and proactively escalate overdue vulnerabilities, blockers, and risks.
* identify recurring vulnerability patterns and recommend systemic solutions and preventive controls to reduce repeat findings.
* integrate vulnerability and security scanning into ci/cd and devsecops pipelines, enabling earlier identification of vulnerabilities during the software development lifecycle.
* support cloud security posture assessments and remediation of configuration weaknesses across azure, aws, and hybrid-cloud environments.
* develop scripts and automation to improve vulnerability identification, remediation tracking, validation, reporting, and compliance evidence collection.
* create dashboards and reports covering open vulnerabilities, remediation aging, sla compliance, risk acceptance, remediation trends, and vulnerability reduction.
* participate in vulnerability governance and operational review meetings and communicate technical risks, remediation status, dependencies, and blockers to engineering and management stakeholders.

**basic qualifications:**  

* minimum 7+ years of experience in it engineering, cloud engineering, devops/sre, cybersecurity, application security, or vulnerability management within enterprise environments.
* minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in vulnerability management / application security / cloud security, including vulnerability analysis, prioritization, remediation, and validation.
* minimum 4+ years of experience working with public cloud technologies, with strong hands-on knowledge of aws and/or microsoft azure.
* minimum 2+ years of experience supporting hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud environments, preferably involving application migration or transformation between azure and aws.
* minimum 3+ years of experience using enterprise vulnerability/security platforms such as qualys, tenable, rapid7, wiz, prisma cloud, microsoft defender for cloud, aws inspector, or comparable tools.
* minimum 3+ years of experience analyzing and remediating cve/cvss-based vulnerabilities, including operating-system vulnerabilities, application dependencies, open-source libraries, containers, and cloud infrastructure.
* minimum 2+ years of experience supporting security or vulnerability management for apache spark, databricks, emr, hadoop, or similar large-scale data-processing platforms.
* minimum 2+ years of experience working with java/jvm applications and open-source dependency vulnerability remediation, including upgrading vulnerable libraries and packages.
* minimum 2+ years of experience working with containers and container orchestration technologies such as docker and kubernetes, including container/image vulnerability management.
* minimum 2+ years of experience with ci/cd and devsecops technologies such as gitlab ci, github actions, jenkins, azure devops, or comparable platforms.
* minimum 2+ years of experience integrating or working with security controls such as sast, dast, software composition analysis (sca), container scanning, secrets scanning, and infrastructure-as-code scanning.
* minimum 2+ years of experience with scripting or automation using python, bash, powershell, or equivalent technologies.

**preferred skills:**  

* strong understanding of aws and azure security concepts, including iam/access controls, cloud configuration, network security, logging/monitoring, and cloud security posture management.
* strong knowledge of vulnerability-management concepts including cve, cvss, risk-based prioritization, patch management, vulnerability slas, remediation validation, security exceptions, and risk acceptance.
* strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills with the ability to translate security findings into actionable technical remediation for engineering teams.

**travel:**  

* this position may require occasional travel based on client and project requirements.

**degree:**  

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or equivalent work experience.

**nice to have:**  

* experience working in banking, financial services, or other highly regulated enterprise environments.
* experience securing enterprise data platforms utilizing apache spark, databricks, aws emr, kafka, hadoop, or related technologies.
* experience with cloud security services including aws security hub, inspector, guardduty, cloudtrail, config, microsoft defender for cloud, azure policy, and entra id.
* experience with infrastructure as code technologies such as terraform and aws cloudformation.
* knowledge of security standards and frameworks including nist, cis benchmarks, owasp, and cloud security best practices.
* experience implementing automated vulnerability-remediation and security-validation workflows.
* experience applying ai/llm-based capabilities to vulnerability analysis, remediation recommendations, or security automation.
* familiarity with sre, observability, production support, and incident-management practices.
* relevant certifications such as aws certified security – specialty, microsoft azure security engineer, cissp, ccsp, security+, or equivalent cloud/security certifications.
